description: Machine-readable index of the open modules in lib/openstartup/: per module its entrypoint file, exported functions, the registered entrypoint with a JSON Schema for its positional arguments, a runnable example call with its result shape, and the catalog status line from open-modules/README.md. Generated from the entry specs beside each module by scripts/generate-module-registry.ts — edit the specs or the catalog, never this file.
invalidInput: Registered entrypoints validate their positional arguments against inputSchema and raise a RangeError naming the function, argument, and field on structurally malformed input; semantic rules (ranges, dates, share arithmetic) raise their own named RangeErrors.

entrypoint.note: Structurally malformed events throw; semantically invalid events (bad amounts, overdrawn pools) report via the returned report.error with earlier snapshots preserved.
decodeCapTableState is the inverse and returns null on any malformed token.

modules.title: Deadline calendar
modules.status: verified, always `needsReview` where dates can move

modules.title: R&D tax mechanics
modules.status: explanation + arithmetic — never a credit computation
